name: SkillGenBench
intro: SkillGenBench 是一个用于评估 LLM Agent 技能生成流水线的基准。它将原始仓库或长文档交给生成器，要求生成标准化的 SKILL.md 工件，再在固定 harness 中执行并用统一评测流程判断技能是否正确、可复用且可执行，覆盖任务可见与任务不可见两种生成设置。
build_method: 仓库与文档源构建, 固定harness执行, 确定性检查
modality: 文本, 代码, 文档
task_type: Agent技能生成, 工具使用, 过程执行
eval_feature: 技能生成, 仓库理解, 文档理解, 执行验证
scale: 2种生成设置, 2类程序源, 5种生成方法
task_type_en: Agent skill generation, Tool use, Procedure execution
build_method_en: Repository and document source construction, fixed-harness execution, deterministic checks
eval_feature_en: Skill generation, repository understanding, document understanding, execution verification
intro_en: SkillGenBench evaluates skill-generation pipelines for LLM agents. A generator receives raw repositories or long documents, produces standardized SKILL.md artifacts, and the generated skills are executed under fixed harnesses and assessed with unified procedures for correctness, reusability, and executability across task-conditioned and task-agnostic generation settings.
scale_en: 2 generation regimes, 2 procedural source types, 5 generation methods
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect fixed-commit repository snapshots and long-form document bundles"] --> B["Construct knowledge graphs with entities, relations, communities, and procedural evidence"]
    B --> C["Generate practical multi-section application scenarios from KG summaries and sources"]
    C --> D["Create function-style task specifications, hidden test cases, and solve functions"]
    D --> E["Filter candidates using LLM quality checks, pretrain-only checks, and with-corpus checks"]
    E --> F["Manually audit clarity, challenge level, source alignment, verifiability, and benchmark fit"]
    F --> G["Iteratively validate accepted tasks with reference skills and refinements"]
    G --> H["Retain 187 repository- and document-grounded skill-generation tasks"]
    H --> I["Evaluate generated SKILL.md artifacts in pinned environments with fixed execution harnesses"]

flowchart LR
    A["收集固定提交的仓库快照和长文档包"] --> B["构建包含实体、关系、社区和过程证据的知识图谱"]
    B --> C["基于KG摘要和源材料生成真实多章节应用场景"]
    C --> D["生成函数式任务规格、隐藏测试用例和solve函数"]
    D --> E["用LLM质量检查、无语料检查和带语料检查过滤候选任务"]
    E --> F["人工审核清晰度、挑战度、源材料对齐、可验证性和基准适配性"]
    F --> G["用参考skill和迭代修订验证保留任务"]
    G --> H["保留187个仓库和文档驱动的skill生成任务"]
    H --> I["在固定环境和执行harness中评估生成的SKILL.md工件"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.18693. The paper describes a five-stage SkillGenBench construction pipeline: repository/document sources are abstracted into knowledge graphs; task scenarios are proposed and filtered; each scenario yields tasks and test cases; tasks that are solvable without procedural extraction or trivially solvable with full corpus are filtered; remaining tasks are validated with an iteratively refined reference skill. It also reports manual inspection of 678 candidate tasks and retention of 187 tasks, with generated skills evaluated in containerized pinned environments under fixed harnesses using execution-based and artifact-based checks.
